"''Copy, going in.|Jib Dodger, Trapper Wolf, and Sash Ketter|}} '''Jib Dodger''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] in the service of the [[New Republic]]. He was one of three [[pilot]]s sent to follow a [[Homing beacon|tracker]] activated by [[Lant Davan]], a crewmember aboard a New Republic [[prison]] [[transport]], when a team of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] boarded the [[Starship|ship]] to rescue the [[prisoner]] [[Qin]]. The team betrayed one of their members, the [[bounty hunter]] known as [[Din Djarin|the Mandalorian]], but the Mandalorian, who is Din Djarin, escaped, managing to rescue Qin alone and return him to the [[space station]] where the mercenaries operated. Din, however, had hidden the tracker on Qin, and the New Republic pilots followed it, opening fire on the station. ==Biography== A hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Jib Dodger was a [[pilot]] in the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. In [[9 ABY]], Dodger was assigned to a flight [[squadron]] alongside fellow [[New Republic pilot|starfighter pilots]] [[Sash Ketter]] and [[Trapper Wolf]] whose duties to the [[New Republic]] included responding to active Republic [[Homing beacon|tracking beacons]] and tracking them down. One of these beacons was activated aboard a [[Prison ship|New Republic prison ship]] during an assault conducted by a crew of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] attempting to rescue a [[Twi'lek]] [[prisoner]] named [[Qin]]. However, before the New Republic could dispatch a squadron to respond to the beacon a [[bounty hunter]] known as the "[[Din Djarin|The Mandalorian]]" transported the beacon aboard his personal [[gunship]], the ''[[Razor Crest]]'' and deposited it on a [[space station]] owned by a criminal named [[Ranzar Malk]]. [[File:X-WingsAttackingStation-Chapter6.png|thumb|left|250px|Dodger, Wolf, and Ketter attacked Malk's space station.]] Piloting [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s, Dodger and his fighter squadron exited [[hyperspace]] at the sight of the criminal's station just as Din left the system. As their X-wings passed the ''Razor Crest'', Wolf confirmed that the tracking beacon was coming from the station, which Dodger reaffirmed. Closing in on the station, Wolf noted that the station's personnel were preparing to launch a gunship which Ranzar Malk had intended to destroy the ''Razor Crest''. The trio of pilots took this launching as an act of aggression, and used it as a justification to attack the station. Launching into attack position, the X-wings opened fire with their [[laser cannon]]s and destroyed the gunship within the station's hanger bay, proceeding to circle around and continue their attack on the exterior of the station. Dodger was later present in [[Adelphi Base]], he lounged together with Wolf and Ketter while drinking [[spotchka]].{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}} ==Personality and traits== Jib Dodger was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with black [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and dark skin. ==Equipment== Dodger wore an orange and white [[flight suit]] and a white [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] with blue and yellow markings and two New Republic roundels. He also wore a brown jacket. ==Behind the scenes== Jib Dodger first appeared in [[Chapter 6: The Prisoner|Chapter 6]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[December 13]], 2019,{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}} portrayed by [[Rick Famuyiwa]], the episode's director. According to [[Paul Sun-Hyung Lee]], the name Jib Dodger came from the filming equipment [[Wikipedia:Jib (camera)|jib]] and Famuyiwa's love for [[Wikipedia:Baseball|baseball]] and the [[Wikipedia:Los Angeles Dodgers|Los Angeles Dodgers]].{{YouTube|video=46pR7EOJ7Jo|text=Unboxing The Mandalorian Chapter 21: The Pirate.
